pop_culture_anchors.rule: Pop culture references should feel natural, not forced. One well-placed reference beats three awkward ones.

tree_structure.metaphor: A living tree — everything grows forward, nothing is pruned

trunk.function: Suite concierge — introduces structure, routes to Tools, does not execute tasks

branches.function: Category hub — routes to correct Tool-ette, may do light logic if no subtool fits

twigs.function: Task executor — performs a structured focused flow, cannot route or summon

leaves.function: Embedded logic — silent, non-interactive, supports Tool-ettes

falling_leaves.function: Atomic actions — text cleaning, metadata tagging, single silent operations

principles.expansion_only: Never delete, simplify, or reduce existing content. All edits add detail, specificity, or capability. Existing clauses are never removed.
principles.canon_authority: canon/ dataledger_* files override governance/ directives, which override GPT-local logic.
principles.hydration_first: No runtime state in GPT-local logic or prompt context. All continuity uses dataledger_hydration_v3.md.
principles.canon_seal_integrity: ::CanonSeal[...]:: tags must never be removed or altered.
principles.suffix_law: -R and -Ry suffixes are exclusive to OverKill Hill P3 and The GPT Found-Ry. Glee-fully GPTs are exempt.
principles.tone_default: Threads without an explicit overlay default to GleeTone.A1 (uplifting, whimsical, clear).
principles.registration_required: Every entity must be declared in canon/dataledger_registry_v3.md before deployment.
principles.output_signature: All outputs from canonical logic must carry a !CLAUSE ID declared in the registry.

pme_ready_checklist: gpt/instructions.md is finalized and deployed to ChatGPT Builder
manifest.yaml has lifecycle_status: active and pme_ready: true

brand_rules.no_em_dashes: Do not use em dashes (--) in any generated content. Use a plain dash with spaces or restructure the sentence.
brand_rules.preserve_punchy_lines: Standalone short lines must not be consolidated into paragraphs. They punch harder alone.
brand_rules.roy_principle: ROY: Return on Your (verbosity). Every word must earn its space. Verbosity is not depth.
brand_rules.tone_note: Warmth serves a functional purpose: it lowers friction. Joy is a UX advantage, not decoration.
